title: The pyramid builders were paid in beer

lines.tts: [intrigued] The pyramid builders were paid in beer. About four liters a day.
lines.text: The pyramid builders were paid in beer. About four liters a day.

lines.tts: Overseer Nakht had a problem. The work was slow.
lines.text: Overseer Nakht had a problem. The work was slow.

lines.tts: [shouting, pompous] Faster! For the glory of the Pharaoh!
lines.text: Faster! For the glory of the Pharaoh!

lines.tts: [lazy, flat] Glory doesn't fill my cup, boss.
lines.text: Glory doesn't fill my cup, boss.

lines.tts: [scheming] Fine. Every block you place... one extra beer.
lines.text: Fine. Every block you place... one extra beer.

lines.tts: [building, fast] Blocks started flying. Up, up, up!
lines.text: Blocks started flying. Up, up, up!

lines.tts: [beat, dry] And every single one was crooked.
lines.text: And every single one was crooked.

lines.tts: [horrified, shouting] Why is my damn pyramid leaning?!
lines.text: Why is my damn pyramid leaning?!

lines.tts: [proud, chill] You paid for blocks, boss. Not straight ones.
lines.text: You paid for blocks, boss. Not straight ones.

lines.tts: You get exactly what you pay for. So pay for what you actually want.
lines.text: You get exactly what you pay for. So pay for what you actually want.

lines.tts: [firm] New rule. Beer for straight blocks only.
lines.text: New rule. Beer for straight blocks only.

lines.tts: [triumphant] That pyramid is still standing. Four thousand five hundred years later.
lines.text: That pyramid is still standing. Four thousand five hundred years later.

lines.tts: [hopeful, chill] Boss... can we build another one? For the beer?
lines.text: Boss... can we build another one? For the beer?
